bible_verses.english: I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunders, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!”

The four living creatures each one of them, having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy, is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!”
saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who was slain to receive power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God Almighty, You reign in beauty, holiness, and love over every detail of my life. Thank You for sending Jesus, the Worthy Lamb, who gave His life to bring me into Your presence. When life feels uncertain, fix my eyes on Your eternal throne and quiet my soul with Your sovereignty. Teach me to lift my worship today not out of duty, but out of glad, overflowing joy for who You are. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When we sing "Agnus Dei," we join our voices with the grand choir of heaven, declaring that our Almighty God reigns supreme over all things. In every season of life, echoing this ancient truth anchors our hearts in His absolute holiness and gentle sovereignty. Looking to the slain yet risen Lamb, our worry transforms into reverent wonder and joyful praise. Today, let the majesty of Jesus draw you into a resting, worshipful trust in the One who holds history in His hands.
